configuration_guides.configuration_guide: Interface and Hardware Components Configuration Guide, Cisco IOS XE Dublin 17.12.x (Catalyst 9300 Switches)

sections.section: Configuring an Interface - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. interface
4. Follow each interface command with the interface configuration commands that the interface requires.
5. interface range or interface range macro
6. show interfaces
sections.examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet1/0/1 Device(config-if)#

sections.section: Adding a Description for an Interface - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. interface interface-id
4. description string
5. end
6. show interfaces interface-id description
7. copy running-config startup-config
sections.examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet1/0/2
Device(config-if)# description Connects to Marketing
Device(config-if)# end
Device# copy running-config startup-config

sections.section: Configuring a Range of Interfaces - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. interface range { port-range | macro macro_name }
4. end
5. show interfaces [ interface-id ]
6. copy running-config startup-config
sections.examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# interface range macro
Device(config)# end
Device# show interfaces
Device# copy running-config startup-config

sections.section: Configuring and Using Interface Range Macros - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. define interface-range macro_name interface-range
4. interface range macro macro_name
5. end
6. show running-config | include define
7. copy running-config startup-config
sections.examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# define interface-range enet_list gigabitethernet1/0/1 - 2
Device(config)# interface range macro enet_list
Device(config)# end
Device# show running-config | include define
Device# copy running-config startup-config

sections.section: Setting the Interface Speed and Duplex Parameters - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. interface interface-id
4. speed { 10 | 100 | 1000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 | auto [ 10 | 100 | 1000 | 2500 | 5000 | 10000 ] | nonegotiate }
5. duplex { auto | full | half }
6. end
7. show interfaces interface-id
8. copy running-config startup-config
sections.examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet1/0/3
Device(config-if)# speed 10
Device(config-if)# duplex half
Device(config-if)# end
Device# show interfaces gigabitethernet1/0/3
Device# copy running-config startup-config

sections.section: Configuring Network-Policy TLV - Procedure

sections.section: Configuring Location TLV and Wired Location Service - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. configure terminal
2. location { admin-tag string | civic-location identifier { id | host } | elin-location string identifier id | custom-location identifier { id | host } | geo-location identifier { id | host }}
3. exit
4. interface interface-id
5. location { additional-location-information word | civic-location-id { id | host } | elin-location-id id | custom-location-id { id | host } | geo-location-id { id | host } }
6. end
7. Use one of the following: show location admin-tag string show location civic-location identifier id show location elin-location identifier id
8. copy running-config startup-config
sections.examples:
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# location civic-location identifier 1
Device(config-civic)# number 3550
Device(config-civic)# primary-road-name "Cisco Way"
Device(config-civic)# city "San Jose"
Device(config-civic)# state CA
Device(config-civic)# building 19
Device(config-civic)# room C6
Device(config-civic)# county "Santa Clara"
Device(config-civic)# country US
Device(config-civic)# exit
Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet2/0/1
Device(config-if)# location elin-location-id 1
Device(config-if)# end
Device# show location admin-tag or
Device# show location civic-location identifier or
Device# show location elin-location identifier
Device# copy running-config startup-config

sections.section: Configuring Power Policing - Procedure
sections.commands:
1. enable
2. configure terminal
3. interface interface-id
4. power inline police [ action { log | errdisable }]
5. exit
6. Use one of the following: errdisable detect cause inline-power errdisable recovery cause inline-power errdisable recovery interval interval
7. exit
8. Use one of the following: show power inline police show errdisable recovery
9. copy running-config startup-config
sections.examples:
Device> enable
Device# configure terminal
Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet2/0/1
Device(config-if)# power inline police
Device(config-if)# exit
Device(config)# errdisable detect cause inline-power
Device(config)# errdisable recovery cause inline-power
Device(config)# errdisable recovery interval 100
Device(config)# exit
Device# show power inline police
Device# show errdisable recovery
Device# copy running-config startup-config

;;Assume a preconfigured IPv6 prefix list as follows:

Device(config-dhcp-guard)# preference max 250
Device(config-dhcp-guard)# preference min 150
